title: Synchronised dual view: front and side
description: The user's split-screen prompt: two fixed orthographic cameras, the same motion, frame-level sync.

body.subject: Split-screen video with two fixed orthographic cameras showing the same armoured warrior, exactly as in [start_image], at the same moment: left panel the exact front view, right panel the exact side view. {{design_lock}}.
body.action: He walks in place at a steady natural pace of {{cadence_spm}} steps per minute, both panels the identical motion, perfectly synchronized.
body.camera: Both cameras locked off: no camera movement, no zoom, no cuts, no perspective change.
body.style: Flat even studio light, plain light-grey backdrop in both panels.
body.constraints: Full body in frame in both panels, feet touching the floor line, exactly two arms and two legs, same armour design in both views.

design_lock.default: dark bronze plate armour, gold lion-head pauldrons, crimson cloth skirt with a gold meander hem, black undersuit
design_lock.description: what must stay unchanged: the design in words

start_image.description: an image showing the front view left and the side view right

bytedance/seedance*.note: names references in prose; roles are start_image / end_image / video references

higgsfield/*.note: Higgsfield media roles: start_image, end_image, image_references, video_references

heygen/*.note: audio is always on and not controllable; only a first frame is taken
